briefings.title: Treasury Sec. Bessent and Larry Kudlow participate in a fireside chat at G20 meeting — 9/1/26
briefings.tldr: Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent and host Larry Kudlow attribute a booming U.S. economy to President Trump's tax cuts, deregulation, and energy expansion, while detailing aggressive economic warfare and blockades to asphyxiate the Iranian regime.

briefings.title: Trump deal with Iran, gas prices, economics & more addressed during Scott Bessent, Larry Kudlow chat
briefings.tldr: Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent outlines how the administration's "Operation Economic Fury" and naval blockade have financially crippled Iran, forcing them to negotiate on nuclear enrichment, while domestic supply-side economic reforms and the newly launched Trump Savings Accounts continue to drive historic U.S. business investment and consumer resilience.

briefings.title: 'GREATEST PERIOD WE'VE EVER SEEN': Trump touts pro-growth policies
briefings.tldr: President Donald Trump projects an era of historic economic expansion, targeting 15% GDP growth through a combination of aggressive tariffs, energy deregulation, and a "growth-first" Federal Reserve.
